title: Glitch in the Timeline
blurb: Games, movies, shows and space from 2000 to 2025. Three facts per card, and one is cap.

cards.say: The Nintendo Switch [was code-named NX while it was being made], [has game cards coated to taste awful so kids won't swallow them], [had shipped more than 150 million units by the end of 2025], and [came out with Super Mario Odyssey on its very first day].
cards.real: The Switch came out on March 3, 2017. Super Mario Odyssey didn't arrive until October 27, 2017.

cards.say: Pokémon Go [grew out of a Google Maps April Fools' joke], [was made by Nintendo's own game studio], [had Pokémon you could catch in only one part of the world], and [had eggs you had to walk 10 kilometers to hatch].
cards.real: It was made by Niantic, a company that started inside Google. Nintendo helped pay for it but didn't make it.

cards.say: The Super Mario Bros. Movie [made more than a billion dollars around the world], [had Jack Black as the voice of Bowser], [was the very first movie ever made about Mario], and [put Bowser's song Peaches on the Billboard Hot 100].
cards.real: A live-action Super Mario Bros. movie came out back in 1993, thirty years earlier.

cards.say: Shrek [was made by Pixar, the studio behind Toy Story], [won the first Oscar ever given for Best Animated Feature], [is based on a picture book that came out in 1990], and [had its star redo all his lines in a Scottish accent].
cards.real: Shrek was made by DreamWorks. It even beat Pixar's Monsters, Inc. to win that first Oscar.

cards.say: Frozen [is loosely based on a fairy tale called The Snow Queen], [had Elsa written as a villain at first], [was the first animated movie to make a billion dollars], and [won an Oscar for the song Let It Go].
cards.real: Toy Story 3 got there first, in 2010, three years before Frozen came out.

cards.say: Lightning McQueen [races as number 95 because Toy Story came out in 1995], [is named after Glenn McQueen, an animator at Pixar], [got a Crocs shoe made to look like him in 2021], and [wins the Piston Cup at the end of the first Cars movie].
cards.real: He stops just short of the finish line to help The King, and Chick Hicks takes the Piston Cup.

cards.say: Encanto [is set in a magical house in the mountains of Colombia], [won an Oscar for the song We Don't Talk About Bruno], [won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature], and [gave Disney its first number one song since Aladdin].
cards.real: Bruno wasn't even nominated. Encanto's nominated song was Dos Oruguitas, and it lost.

cards.say: Bluey [is made at a studio in Sydney, Australia], [has episodes that are usually just seven minutes long], [has a mom, Chilli, who works part-time in airport security], and [won an International Emmy Kids Award in 2019].
cards.real: Bluey is made by Ludo Studio in Brisbane, Australia.

cards.say: The International Space Station [is too small to see from the ground without a telescope], [lets the astronauts on board see 16 sunrises every day], [is about as big as a football field], and [had two Barbie dolls on board in 2022].
cards.real: You can see it with just your eyes. Around dawn or dusk it's one of the brightest things in the sky, after the Moon and Venus.

cards.say: Moana [had a 14-year-old picked to be the voice of Moana], [has a demigod, Maui, whose tattoos were drawn by hand], [has a rooster named Heihei who sneaks onto her boat], and [has a pet pig, Pua, who sails with her the whole way].
cards.real: Pua stays home on the island. Heihei the rooster is the one who ends up on the voyage.

cards.say: The 2024 solar eclipse [passed over Mexico, the United States and Canada], [could be seen as a total eclipse in 15 U.S. states], [crossed the United States from California to Maine], and [turned day into night for over four minutes in some places].
cards.real: It came up from Mexico into Texas and left the country over Maine. California wasn't on the path at all.

cards.say: Diary of a Wimpy Kid [started out online on a kids' website in 2004], [became a movie for the first time in 2021], [was written by the man who created Poptropica], and [has an author who opened his own bookstore].
cards.real: The first Diary of a Wimpy Kid movie came out in 2010. The 2021 film was a newer, animated one.
